clips.name: FallFront
clips.notes: Grounded face-down knockdown: knees buckle, the body pitches forward over them and lands on the chest and hands; lands in GetupFront's first frame (face down, head toward the opponent), so the getup starts where the fall ends (round 4).

clips.name: KOFront
clips.notes: Face-down KO: a slower forward crumple onto the chest; lands in the same prone pose as FallFront (GetupFront's first frame: face down, head toward the opponent) instead of turning 180 degrees as it lands (round 4).

clips.name: HitHighLight
clips.notes: Jab/straight to the head: head snaps back and away, shoulders follow, weight rocks back with a half step of the lead foot. Starts on the impact pose (shown during hitstop).

clips.name: HitHighHeavy
clips.notes: Heavy/counter hit to the head: big head and torso snap with a twist, arms fly open, the rear foot steps back to catch the weight. Starts on the impact pose (shown during hitstop).

clips.name: HitMidLight
clips.notes: Body shot: the body folds at the waist over the impact, hands drop to the stomach, knees dip. Starts on the impact pose (shown during hitstop).

clips.name: HitMidHeavy
clips.notes: Heavy/counter body hit: deep fold at the waist, knees give, the rear foot steps back. Starts on the impact pose (shown during hitstop).

clips.name: HitLowLight
clips.notes: Shin/low hit: the struck lead leg buckles and is knocked back, the hips dip toward it. Starts on the impact pose (shown during hitstop).

clips.name: HitLowHeavy
clips.notes: Heavy low hit: the lead leg is kicked out from under the body, the knee buckles deep, arms out for balance. Starts on the impact pose (shown during hitstop).

clips.name: Blockstun
clips.notes: Standing block: the guard absorbs the hit, chin tucks, the body is pushed back a little. Starts on the impact pose (shown during hitstop).

clips.name: Stagger
clips.notes: Parried: arms knocked open, off balance, the lead foot steps back. Starts on the impact pose (shown during hitstop).

clips.name: CrouchBlockstun
clips.notes: Crouching block: the low guard absorbs the hit.

clips.name: ThrowBreak
clips.notes: Generic throw break (both roles): hands locked in the clinch shove the opponent away, the body rocks back and the lead foot steps back into the stance. Played over CombatConfig.ThrowBreakFrames from throw.breakFrame.

clips.name: SideRoll
clips.notes: Log roll to the fighter's left (mirrored at runtime for rollDir -1), rolling without slipping: face up the chest turns toward the travel side first (side, belly, other side, back = one full turn by getup frame 13.5 of 36; the sim carries 2.2 studs over the first 10). Face down (prone) the runtime starts at tags.proneStart (belly down) and plays the second half turn (~8 frames). Then a quick sit-up and the face-up mocap getup with the squat hold shortened.

clips.name: BackRoll
clips.notes: Backward roll from lying face up: knees tuck, the hips roll up over the shoulders (hands push off beside the head), the body comes over onto the knees and rises into the stance. The sim carries the body 2.2 studs back over the first 10 frames.

clips.name: Victory_KungFu
clips.notes: Kung-fu victory (Nia): draws the lead foot in and closes the stance, squares up to the beaten opponent, presents the fist-and-palm salute (right fist against the left palm in front of the chest), a short bow, then holds the salute. Starts on her displayed stance.
